scope: Focused final regression: every route at four widths, four lesson guides per width,84 avatar states, teacher/student action frames, feedback/result and source-byte verification. Full activity structural evidence is retained separately.

priorFullActivitySweep.currentScope: The192 activity structural checks are retained with their original hashes; final avatar layer order, hair6 crop and all routes are retested independently in this report.

limits: Automated measurements cannot determine whether a drawing is anatomically sound. The separate per-frame visual verdict is a required gate.
The matrix covers all six skin tones and every free hair/outfit/accessory option through seven configurations; it does not claim visual review of every possible combined avatar.
Chromium/Edge at four viewport widths; other browser engines are not claimed tested.
